The fixture dataset must include not-applicable/pass cases for app-only, library-only, CLI-only, docs-only, health-route, and incidental deploy plans plus S2 fast-pipeline and S3 unit-test boundaries
Unit tests must extend test_new_eval_specs.py and test_t15_overlay_derisk_criterion.py to validate case identifiers, labels, applicability matrix, scorer discipline, and balanced dataset coverage
